Based on a close examination of the Arabic text in the image, here is the word-by-word transcription of the line fragment:

**Transcription:**
**وَأَوْجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى الْوَاطِئِ فِي رَمَضَانَ الْكَفَّارَةُ**

**Analysis of the candidates:**
*   **(A) عليه الصلاة والسلام**: This matches the first part of the middle section exactly. The words are clearly `عليه` (upon him), `الصلاة` (the prayer), and `والسلام` (and peace).
*   **(B) على الواطئ في رمضان والسكيران الكفارة**: This does **not** match. The text clearly reads `عليه` (with a final Ya), not `على`. Furthermore, the word after `رمضان` is `الكفارة` (the expiation/atoneement). There is **no** word `والسكيران` (and the drunkards) visible in the ink between `رمضان` and `الكفارة`.
*   **(C) عليه بلال الصلاة والسلام**: This does **not** match. There is no name `بلال` (Bilal) present between `عليه` and `الصلاة`.

**Conclusion:**
The actual ink matches **Candidate (A)** for the phrase "upon him be prayer and peace," but the complete sentence continues with "on the one who has intercourse in Ramadan [is] the expiation." The OCR reading provided in your prompt (`وأوجب عليه الصلاة والسلام على الواطئ في رمضان الكفارة`) is accurate to what is written in the image.
